freeze_fix_analysis: Root cause identified: vkWaitSemaphores blocking CPU/UI thread in MeshParticleRenderer
Solution: Move all synchronization to GPU using VkSubmitInfo2 timeline semaphores
BLAS build signals timeline=N, TLAS build waits on N and signals N+1
Graphics submit waits on N+1 before executing fragment shader ray queries
CPU thread never blocks, preventing UI freezes
timeline_synchronization_chain: 1. BLAS builds submit with timeline signal=N
2. TLAS builds submit with timeline wait=N, signal=N+1
3. Graphics submit waits on timeline=N+1 before fragment shader
4. Ray queries in fragment shader can safely access shell TLAS
5. All operations are GPU-side, CPU remains responsive
